SELECT fish_date_season AS season, cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(yt) AS yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 180 AND 335
  AND fish_date_season IN (3,4,5)
GROUP BY season, cls, doy_bucket
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket, cls

SELECT 'trips' AS src, fish_date_season AS season, cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/20 AS INT)*20 AS doy_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 1 AND 180
  AND fish_date_season IN (1,2,3,4,5)
GROUP BY season, cls, doy_bucket
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket, cls
